correctness.rationale: A complete relative acyclic matching is specified by the independent exterior-set fibers. Every nonempty fiber has a cone toggle: the alternative forces fully occupied alternating exterior columns and contradicts the twisted boundary for n≡0 or3 (mod4). An induced matching plus one deleted rung gives a join with an edge, so elementary collapsibility follows. Standalone exact enumeration passed eight sizes, without being used as infinite proof.
